articles.title: What DriverX Mobile provides
userMightAsk: What is DriverX Mobile?
Is DriverX like a rideshare app?
articles.answer: DriverX Mobile offers wireless connectivity designed around the needs of drivers, delivery professionals, trucking and logistics teams, and fleets. It is a wireless service, not a rideshare-dispatch or driver-payments app. You can explore mobile plans and coverage information on the official DriverX website.
articles.doNotImply: Do not imply gig-platform affiliation or guaranteed earnings.

articles.title: Choose a driver profile
userMightAsk: Do you have plans for DoorDash drivers?
What if I drive a truck?
articles.answer: Tell me which best describes your work: rideshare, deliveries, long-haul or logistics, fleet management, or general mobile use. I can point you to relevant published options and explain the trade-offs between data, hotspot, and coverage without guaranteeing a particular outcome.

articles.title: Public support contact
userMightAsk: How do I contact DriverX?
Do you have a support phone number?
articles.answer: For direct help, use DriverX Mobile’s official support page or the contact details published there. I can explain your issue and help you prepare the questions to ask; I cannot confirm that a human agent is online or that a case has been opened.
articles.doNotImply: Verified contact URL only. Link and phone must be periodically rechecked.

articles.title: Network outage or downtime
userMightAsk: Is the network down right now?
Has the outage been fixed?
articles.answer: I cannot confirm a real-time outage from this public chat unless an approved, live status integration provides that information. If you have no service, we can run safe basic checks and I can direct you to the official support channel.

userMightAsk: Connect me to a person
I need urgent human support
articles.answer: You can reach DriverX through its official public contact channels. I can summarize the public troubleshooting steps to mention, but a chat-to-agent transfer, ticket number, agent availability, or response time must not be claimed unless a connected support system confirms it.

articles.title: Accessibility support
userMightAsk: Can I use this with a screen reader?
Is your chatbot keyboard accessible?
articles.answer: Drixo is being designed to support keyboard navigation, readable controls, and screen-reader announcements. For an issue with accessibility on the website, use the official contact channel. Do not assume a specific accommodation or completed certification unless confirmed by an accessibility assessment.

userMightAsk: Does buying a plan activate my SIM?
What happens after checkout?
articles.answer: Choosing or buying a plan and activating your SIM/eSIM are separate steps. First compare plan terms, then confirm device compatibility, and then use the official activation instructions when you are ready. I cannot activate service from this public chat.

articles.title: Bring your own phone
userMightAsk: Can I bring my own unlocked phone?
Will my phone work?
articles.answer: You may be able to use your own unlocked phone, depending on device and network compatibility. Check the phone’s lock status and the official compatibility requirements before buying or activating. I cannot verify your specific device or IMEI in this public conversation.

articles.title: Understand eSIM basics
userMightAsk: What is an eSIM?
How do I install DriverX eSIM?
articles.answer: An eSIM is a digital SIM profile supported by some devices. Before setup, check that your phone supports eSIM and is unlocked, and connect to Wi-Fi if installation needs a data connection. Follow the exact instructions provided in your approved activation channel; do not post a QR code or activation credentials here.
articles.doNotImply: No claim that QR issuance or instant provisioning is available through Drixo.

articles.title: Physical SIM installation
userMightAsk: How do I install my SIM?
Where does my physical SIM go?
articles.answer: Turn off your device if its manufacturer recommends doing so, insert the supplied SIM using the device’s instructions, and restart as directed. Verify mobile service only after the carrier’s activation process is complete. For device-specific steps, consult your device manufacturer or official DriverX instructions.
articles.doNotImply: Do not repeat unverified *611 or 60-second activation promises.

articles.title: Keep your existing phone number

articles.answer: Eligible numbers may be transferred from an existing carrier. The published preparation guidance calls for your current account number and transfer PIN; keep your existing service active until the transfer completes. Submit these details only through an authorized secure transfer channel, not in Drixo chat.

articles.title: General connection failure
userMightAsk: My mobile data stopped working
I have no internet during deliveries
articles.answer: When safely parked, first check whether calls and texts work. Then check your phone’s signal indicator, mobile-data setting, and whether the issue affects all apps or only one. I can guide you through one step at a time, but I cannot detect or repair your carrier network from this chat.
articles.doNotImply: Deterministic flow; ask one branching question at a time.

articles.title: Calls work, data does not
userMightAsk: Calls work but mobile data is down
Texts are fine but apps cannot connect
articles.answer: If calls and texts work but data does not, check that mobile data is enabled for the correct SIM and that airplane mode is off while you are parked. Try a normal device restart and retest one app. If the problem continues, contact official support; avoid changing APN settings without verified device-specific instructions.

articles.title: No signal or calls
userMightAsk: My phone says no service
I cannot call or text
articles.answer: When safely parked, check whether your phone recognizes the SIM and whether your location or surroundings may affect reception. You can try restarting your phone, then check published coverage guidance and contact support if the issue persists. I cannot tell whether there is a live outage without an approved status feed.

articles.title: Only one app is failing
userMightAsk: Only my delivery app is not loading
Maps works but one app fails
articles.answer: If other websites and apps work, the problem may be specific to that app. Check the app’s own service status, updates, and permissions, and contact its support when appropriate. Drixo cannot access your rideshare or delivery-platform account or guarantee the third-party app will recover.

articles.title: Slow mobile data
userMightAsk: Why is my internet slow?
My GPS takes forever to load
articles.answer: Mobile speeds can change with location, device capabilities, congestion, network conditions, and plan terms. When parked, test whether the slowdown occurs in several apps and review current plan information. I cannot confirm an exact speed or network condition for your phone through public chat.

articles.title: Mobile hotspot will not connect
userMightAsk: My laptop cannot connect to my hotspot
Is mobile hotspot broken?
articles.answer: When parked, confirm that cellular data works on the phone first. Then check that hotspot is enabled, your other device is using the correct Wi-Fi network and password, and your plan’s published hotspot allowance supports your needs. I cannot inspect current line usage or change your hotspot allowance here.

articles.title: High-speed data allowance explained
userMightAsk: What happens after my data limit?
Is unlimited always full speed?
articles.answer: Plans may distinguish high-speed data from reduced-speed use after a threshold, and hotspot limits can differ from phone data. Read the effective plan terms and Broadband Consumer Label before purchase. I will not describe any plan as unlimited high-speed unless the current approved terms explicitly say that.
articles.doNotImply: Homepage example: Unlimited plan advertises 35 GB high-speed then 2G; do not publish without sign-off.
